entry.title: Nano Kava — the world's first ~18nm kava nanoemulsion
entry.summary: Nano-emulsified kava with an approximately 18 nanometer droplet size: ~10x the bioavailability of traditional kava extract, 80–90% kavalactone absorption, ~5-minute onset, crystal clear and fully water-soluble.
